description: Paris 2024 – vélo – déviations et restrictions d’itinéraires cyclables en lien avec l’organisation des jeux is a dataset listed in Paris Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Direction de la Voirie et des Déplacements - Ville de Paris. Dans le cadre de l’organisation des jeux olympiques et paralympiques Paris 2024, - Des itinéraires cyclables sont rendus inaccessibles afin de permettre l’organisation de l’événement. - Des itinéraires cyclables de contournement sont proposés en substitution des itinéraires inaccessibles. Ces itinéraires utilisent des infrastructures préexistantes ou spécifiquement mises en place pour le contournement. Coverage: Paris. The portal files it under Mobilité et Espace Public. Its keywords are vélo, piste cyclable, Jeux Olympiques, voirie. The portal shows 82 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-06-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-paris-fr-portal.
